Proposition
[Hessian via the covariant derivative]

Source: petersen:page-0076, petersen:page-0077 ↗ def:pet-ch2-covariant-derivative-tensor ↗ def:pet-ch2-hessian-lie-derivative

1. ch2:2.2.6For $f:(M,g) o \mathbb {R}$, $( abla df)(X,Y)=g( abla _X abla f,Y)=\operatorname {Hess}f(X,Y)$.
Proof

↗ prop:pet-ch2-hessian-covariant-derivative

\sketch Directly from the tensor derivative of subsection 2.2,

\[ ( abla _Xdf)(Y)=D_XD_Yf-D_{ abla _XY}f. \]

Torsion-freeness makes this expression symmetric in $X,Y$. Metric compatibility also gives $( abla _Xdf)(Y)=g( abla _X abla f,Y)$. Expanding $ frac 12L_{ abla f}g$ and replacing brackets by torsion-free covariant derivatives produces the same symmetric expression, hence all three tensors agree.

□
